newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-HOOPER COMPLETES CENTURY FOR WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HOOPER COMPLETES CENTURY FOR WEST INDIES.

text.p: Carl Hooper completed his seventh test century as the West Indies progressed to 370 for seven wickets in their first innings at lunch on the second day of the first test against India on Friday.
Hooper, resuming on 87, took a further 28 minutes to complete his century and went on to make 129 before he was caught by Venkatesh Prasad off the bowling of debutant paceman Abey Kuruvilla.

The West Indies, with nightwatchman Ian Bishop partnering Hooper, began at 300 for four and the Indians went wicketless for most of the morning before breaking through three times in the last 35 minutes.
Hooper and Bishop added 57 runs before Bishop was out for 24, lofting Anil Kumble to deep mid-off where Sunil Joshi took a well-judged, running catch.
Hooper followed half an hour later while Junior Murray made just one before falling leg before to Kumble on the stroke of lunch.
